text:
Carla: Heads-up — I'm putting a draft proposal for a telemetry gating + JSON schema v4 into the doc bucket. Goal: reduce PII/high-cardinality noise from GPU fleet logs while keeping observability for SLOs and provisioning decisions.

Carla: Key ideas: 1) region-aware sampling rules, 2) hashed host_id instead of raw hostnames, 3) explicit `telemetry.policy` header to route low/high fidelity, 4) move KV-cache keys into opt-in "cache_meta" with strict redaction.

Carla: Example snippet: 
```json
{
  "schema_version": "telemetry.v4",
  "labels": {
    "region": "us-west-2",
    "instance_type": "p4d",
    "host_id_hash": "sha256:...",
    "job_role": "serve"
  },
  "sampling": {
    "default_pct": 5,
    "region_overrides": {"us-east-1": 10}
  }
}
```

Mike: Nice. How will this interact with Prometheus/Grafana dashboards? logs -> we rely on `region` + `instance_type` labels to aggregate. If we sample too much, some histograms (nv_util, queue_latency) might go sparse.

Jen: Also KV cache keys can leak user prompts. We need to ensure `cache_meta` excludes any prefix/token that could be PII. Can we enforce regex whitelist + redact everything else?

Sam: Proposed rollout: canary in us-west-2 (1% traffic -> telemetry.v4 high fidelity), compare SLO deltas for 24h, then expand to other regions with staged sample increases. We should implement a fallback that preserves full fidelity for alerts with severity=page.

Carla: Agreed. Draft sample table: [prod-critical:10%], [prod-background:2%], [staging:20%], [dev:100%], but per-region boost if capacity < 70% to help debugging.

Aleks: Alert tuning note — if we lower cardinality fields (hostnames -> host_id_hash), alert signatures relying on exact host strings will break. We'll need mapping in the alert rules and a temporary no-sampling mode for critical oncall alerts.

Nina: Add KMS/HSM note: any hashed IDs that could be reversible (salted) must be controlled. Use per-region salt managed by KMS and rotate quarterly. Also retention: sampled logs keep 30d, full-fidelity kept 7d for audit only.

Mike: Question on metrics: will we still emit per-GPU telemetry metrics (prom gauge) at full resolution? If logs are sampled we should ensure metrics pipeline remains unaffected.

Carla: Yes metrics remain full-resolution; this is just log envelope sampling + field gating. We'll add a badge in the console showing sampling rate per-route/model.

Sam: Ops rollout checklist: 1) schema validator in ingest, 2) sampling rules config in repo, 3) dashboard diff job to highlight missing buckets, 4) canary alert to catch sudden cardinality drops.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: telemetry-gating/v0.1 -> us-west-2 :thumbsup:

Jen: One more—please add a small eval harness to replay recent noisy tails (large sequence length + cache-miss) against v4 so we can measure debugability impact.

Carla: Thanks — I'll put the PR up with the schema + rollout notes and tag ops/sre for the canary. Expect link in ~30m. :sparkles:
